permissions.view: Analytics: see the dashboards, projects, POs, payments, vendors, anomalies and reports, and export them
permissions.edit: Analytics: accept anomalies, set budgets, head owners, expected dates and PO aliases, save layouts and report templates
permissions.work.own: Project Dashboard: create and own works, mark them started or completed, post weekly and emergency updates
permissions.work.ask: Project Dashboard: ask a work owner for an update
permissions.work.oversee: Project Dashboard: see every work's dates, costs and update text (management)
permissions.pr.raise: Purchase: raise purchase requests and confirm receipt (GRN number, satisfied or not)
permissions.purchase.process: Purchase: add vendor quotes, prepare POs, issue the PO PDF and raise payment requests
permissions.payment.record: Purchase: mark an approved payment request as paid (date, split, UTR, payment advice)
permissions.approve: Purchase: may be named an approver in Settings → Approvals (requests, POs, payments)
permissions.setup: Settings: approvals, projects and numbering, email and templates, defaults, data sources, activity log

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Analytics only: sees every dashboard and report and exports them. Changes nothing.

roles.name: Member (L1)
roles.description: L1 — project managers and engineers: raise purchase requests, own works on the Project Dashboard, post weekly and emergency updates, confirm receipt of what they asked for.

roles.name: Editor
roles.description: Analytics editor: everything a viewer can do, plus budgets, owners, expected dates, PO aliases, anomalies, saved layouts and report templates.

roles.name: Purchase team
roles.description: Purchase team: quotes, POs and the PO PDF, payment requests, recording payments; sees Analytics.

roles.name: Approver (L2)
roles.description: L2 — may be named an approver in Settings → Approvals; asks for updates; analytics editor.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: IT Admin: Settings (approvals, numbering, email, defaults, roles, activity log) and sight of everything — but not raising, pricing, approving or paying.

roles.name: Management (L3)
roles.description: L3 — sees every work with its dates, costs and updates; asks for updates; receives emergencies; may approve.
